title: Spec 015 Tenant current-main audit and authority convergence evidence

phases.objective: Validate historical portfolio evidence, exact-current-main reuse, canonical semantic ownership, owner-approved T006/T008 decisions, and repository-only governance closure without creating duplicate authority or granting runtime mutation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the Spec015 audit regression and canonical-authority validator from the exact candidate tree
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Historical evidence remains immutable; current-main reuse is anchored to 0faee775cd0572b737fed8bc74e2580d9fca2878; T002/T003 are evidence-complete; T006/T008 are owner-approved decision tasks; bounded Phase1 implementation PR design is authorized; cutover, concrete persistence, runtime mutation, migration, provider effects and Production activation remain false.
steps: Validate the historical 2026-08-12 portfolio/candidate evidence separately from the 2026-09-06 authority inventory.
Validate every field-level reuse disposition and canonical semantic boundary.
Validate seven T006 decisions are owner-approved while cutover_executed=false and no physical rename is authorized.
Validate thirteen T008 decisions are owner-approved while runtime_mutation_authorized=false.
Verify current package/version/install/capability/Activity-Pack/System-Tool-Catalog authorities are reused or explicitly compatibility/projection inputs.
Verify copied grant/policy JSON is compatibility-only.
Verify T002/T003/T006/T008 are checked as Phase0 evidence/decision tasks without claiming runtime implementation.
Verify exact-head CI remains an external candidate-SHA-bound attestation requirement rather than source-tree self-state.
Declare repository-only environment impact with no staging or production target and preserve fail-closed target derivation for any actual environment path.
Register this critical E2E declaration in both canonical control-plane registries while preserving manual-merge governance.
Run all validation with no database, provider, migration, credential, Cloudflare, external-send, or Production access.
assertions: No wholesale solution_package_* persistence is approved.
No new execution or permission authority is approved.
Legacy actions is Provider Capability Group semantics; Business Action is separate; no physical rename is authorized.
canonical_capabilities is the semantic target but global runtime cutover requires shadow parity and rollback proof.
T008 owner approval authorizes bounded implementation PR design only; it does not authorize live mutation.
Concrete Component or Installation Revision persistence still requires a proven semantic gap and bounded schema review.
Content Intelligence cannot skip Package foundation, provenance, model/budget, provider certification, idempotency, or readback.
Repository-only declarations may use an empty target set; actual staging/production paths remain target-enforced by environment-impact closure.
Critical control-plane registration does not waive the independent/manual merge requirement.
No candidate merge, migration, provider write, Production mutation, or secret access occurs.
